name: – Anna Strolenberg – § 15 – § 26
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 15. Is deeply concerned by the increasing level of corruption observed in certain Member States and the emergence of corruption cases involving high-level officials and politicians; regrets the lack of cooperation between public institutions and judicial authorities in investigations involving government activities in some Member States, such as the removal of key physical evidence without judicial authorisation in the investigation into the high-speed train collision in Adamuz, Spain, as well as the investigation process regarding the Tempi train collision in Greece; urges the Member States to combat corruption and to fully comply with GRECO’s recommendations, including those in its fifth evaluation round on persons with top executive functions and law enforcement agencies, and with recommendations issued by other relevant international and European bodies, including the European Public Prosecutor’s Office (EPPO), as well as with those stemming from the UN and Council of Europe anti-corruption conventions;
